detail.longDescription: Delft University researchers built a sub-100g drone that navigates by touch instead of sight. Two upward-pointing whiskers with pressure sensors let it feel its way through dark, dusty or smoky spaces where cameras and GPS fail. The whole tactile perception pipeline runs on 34KB of memory and gives sub-millimeter precision. It’s basically a flying mouse that maps the world by whisking. https://www. tomshardware.com/tech-industry /drones/researchers-build-a-drone-that-navigates-with-physical-whiskers-to-operate-in-dark-dusty-or-smoky-places-where-cameras-or-gps-can-fail-sub-100-gram-drones-run-34kb-software-to-enable-sub-millimeter-precision # drones # robotics # bioinspired # research
